'''Geronti''' was a [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], where he served as the chief of the main engine control room onboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']].<ref name="COO" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he alerted senior bridge officer [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] of the unusual opera conducted by [[Sorro]], a companion of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Nuso Esva|Odo]], in the main engine control room.<ref name="COO" />
